items.title: feat: manage projects and who they are shared with from the Control U…
items.summary: feat: manage projects and who they are shared with from the Control UI (#203472) * feat(ui): add Projects tab for project management and role access Adds a Projects tab to the Sessions hub that lists projects with their type, location, and the named roles that can use them. Admins register folders or GitHub clones, rename and remove projects, and share registry projects with roles by editing gateway.roles.definitions..projects through the shared config editor. New Session tells restricted roles when no projects are shared with them and links admins to the tab. * fix(ui): hide Gateway folder browsing from connections without write access * fix(ui): present project role shares explicitly and harden Projects page operations * test(ui): run project share config validation in the node environment * chore: allocate test lines for the Projects tab * chore: correct the Projects tab test-line allocation * fix(ui): reuse shared styles for the Projects tab and cover it in the page census Drops projects.css and the picker wrap rule in favor of existing settings, table, chip and dialog styles so total CSS does not grow; adds the projects route to the engine page census; documents each isolated mock; removes tests duplicated by the config round-trip and E2E coverage; lowers the test-line allocation to 343. * perf(ui): keep the Projects route out of the chat boot bundle Moves the Projects layout boundary into the lazy page module and registers the projectsPage strings with the lazy catalog instead of the startup English catalog, so the new route adds no chat boot JS against a base that already exceeds its cap. * fix(ui): open Projects details from the row like Sessions rows Project names render as plain table text with the repository line beneath, and the row itself is focusable and opens details on click, Enter or Space, matching the Sessions hub table. Drops the ghost button that sat offset from the repository line. * fix(ui): fold Greek sigma in the Projects search Use the shared foldSearchCase helper for the query and each candidate so a final-sigma project name matches σ, Σ and ς queries, as the project picker already does. Drop the Projects page test that only pinned static share copy; the saving test covers the unchecked guest switch.

items.title: Google修補Nest Hub裝置53個漏洞，包括可能導致遠端執行程式碼的藍牙重大漏洞
items.summary: Google於11月23日發布Nest資安公告，修補Nest Hub第2代及Nest Hub Max裝置共53個漏洞，其中27個為High等級、26個為Moderate等級。受影響元件以Bluetooth最多，共39個漏洞，其次是Cast的14個；依問題類型區分，則以服務阻斷（DoS）23個最多，其次為遠端程式碼執行（RCE）16個、權限提升12個。

items.title: Google公布全新AI代理人安全控管介面
items.summary: 因應AI代理人導入為企業帶來潛在的資料及隱私風險，Google週二（11月24日）公布一組專門的代理人控管介面，以現代化建構工具及介面，提供代理人活動的可視度及控管。

items.summary: 網路管理軟體業者SolarWinds於11月24日發布資安公告，修補檔案傳輸軟體Serv-U的重大權限提升漏洞CVE-2026-123167。

items.title: 網擎揭露AI應用布局，從郵件產品功能創新到加速軟體開發與測試
items.summary: 如同其他企業將AI用於輔助內部營運，網擎以此提升技術服務與雲端營運的效率，身為軟體廠商，也將AI用於產品資安功能與軟體工程的強化，希望打造出更安全的產品，並持續推出AI新應用，例如，透過AI協助用戶善用既有的郵件資料，藉此活化組織的記憶資產，或運用AI提升資安產品的威脅偵測與攔截效果。 活用AI提升競爭力是所有企業高度關切的議題，網擎資訊執行長廖長健在近期宣布策略投資微智安聯的記者會上，透露公司內部運用AI的做法。
